rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: /api/devices/dashboard-summary endpoint in device_routes.py returns hardcoded values (connected=true, battery=78/92/65) when any device record exists in DB, instead of reading actual device.connected and device.battery fields
reproduction_steps: 1. Login as Marie Test (phone: 0600000099, password: test123)
2. Check device records in MongoDB: db.devices.find({user_id: '5b9f6c82-c9e2-4202-81de-08c61186071f'}) - shows connected=false, battery=0
4. Dashboard DeviceCards receives this data and shows devices as connected
5. Associer button not visible since device appears connected
rca_of_the_issue.fix: In device_routes.py line 125, change 'connected: bool(bracelet_dev)' to 'connected: bracelet_dev.get("connected", False) if bracelet_dev else False' and 'battery: 78 if bracelet_dev else 0' to 'battery: bracelet_dev.get("battery", 0) if bracelet_dev else 0'. Same changes needed for scale (line 147) and vest (line 165).
